what: a plain, very good knight's longsword, made to be used and well kept: a long straight double-edged blade of clean polished steel, perfectly straight, as straight as a ruler, with one narrow groove down its middle and a sharp point; a plain straight crossguard of dark blackened steel whose two arms end in small rounded knobs; a long grip wound tightly with fresh dark brown leather in neat crossing turns, with a thin strip of leather wound round at each end; and a plain round disc pommel of dark blackened steel. It is plain and honest: no gems, no gold, no engraving.
colours: The blade is neutral bright grey steel with white highlights along its edges and darker grey in the groove; the crossguard and pommel are dark blackened steel with pale grey worn edges; the grip is fresh dark brown leather, the brown of a chestnut.
pose: It lies on a straight diagonal, the pommel at the bottom left corner and the point at the top right corner, the whole sword inside the picture.
must_show: one longsword, straight double-edged blade with a groove
plain dark crossguard and round dark pommel
a long grip wound in dark brown leather

what: a thick round armband that is a brand of raised metal skin, the mark a fallen angel leaves on a wrist: a perfect circle exactly as wide as it is tall, round like a full moon, never oval: a broad thick ring of solid metal with a clear round hole through the middle as wide as half the ring. It is cast bronze, hard shiny metal and not wood or bark: its surface is smooth molten-looking bronze like cooled poured metal, with a few rounded ripples and drips frozen in it, polished dull gold on its highest ridges. It glows from inside like a furnace: across its face run a few wide cracks, and through them shines bright yellow-gold light like the inside of a forge, and the inner rim of the hole glows bright gold too.
colours: Deep burnished bronze metal, dark bronze-brown in the hollows, dull gold shine on the ridges; bright yellow-gold furnace light glowing in the cracks and round the inner rim; the hole in the middle is the backdrop.
pose: Seen straight from the front, flat on, the ring facing the viewer like a full moon so it is a perfect circle with the round hole in the middle, as if hung in the air.
must_show: one thick perfectly round ring with a clear round hole
cast bronze metal, molten-looking, not wood
glowing yellow-gold cracks, like a furnace

what: a charm worn by a death cult: one small round cage of thick black iron wire, shaped like a ball, wider than it is tall, made of four thick curved black wire bars from top to bottom and one thick wire band round its middle, the gaps between the bars wide open. Inside the cage, lying across it sideways and plainly seen between the bars, is one big dried locust, a real grasshopper-like insect drawn large and seen from the side in profile: a long body with a blunt round head and one big dark eye at the left end, long straight folded wings lying along its back to the right, and one huge bent jumping hind leg shaped like a Z, as long as its body, its spiky end poking out between two bars. The locust is dull straw-yellow and brown, dry and dead, with dark brown stripes on its hind leg. The cage hangs from a short closed loop of thick dark brown leather cord tied to a ring at the cage's top, which is part of it; the whole loop is no taller than half the cage and its top end is inside the picture.
colours: Thick black iron wire with pale grey glints; the locust dull straw-yellow and brown with dark brown stripes on its hind leg; dark brown leather cord.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the cage below, the whole thing including the loop's top inside the picture with empty backdrop above it.
must_show: a small round black wire cage
one big locust inside, seen from the side, its long jumping hind leg plain
short cord loop wholly inside the picture

what: a heavy brass cog worn as a mark of a clockmakers' guild: one thick round gear wheel of polished brass, as thick as a finger, with twelve big square teeth all round its rim, each tooth as wide as the gaps between them, a raised inner ring, and four thick spokes crossing to a round hub in the centre, with dark open gaps between the spokes where the backdrop shows through. Its edges are worn bright with handling. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick brass chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the cog itself and joins a sturdy ring at the cog's top tooth.
colours: Bright warm yellow-brown brass like a polished brass door-knob, dark brown in the hollows, pale gold glints on the teeth.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the cog below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one heavy brass cog wheel with square teeth all round
spokes with open gaps between them
